title: Poised Surface Pose
description: A mobile writing app in an iPhone turned toward its feature copy.

import type { CSSProperties } from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Iphone } from "@/registry/magicui/iphone" import { PoisedSurface } from "@/registry/magicui/poised-surface" // The Iphone mock draws a 433 × 882 frame. These numbers come from its // screen and island, so the app sits exactly in the screen and the island // it covers is drawn again on top. const PHONE = { width: 433, height: 882 } const SCREEN = { x: 21.25, y: 19.25, width: 389.5, height: 843.5, radius: 55.75, } const ISLAND = { y: 30, width: 124, height: 37 } // A neutral-200 bezel inside a neutral-300 hairline, so the light frame reads // as a device rather than a white ring. The speaker slot is left out. const frame = cn( "[&>svg>path[opacity]]:hidden", "[&>svg>g>path]:fill-neutral-300 dark:[&>svg>g>path]:fill-neutral-700", "[&>svg>g>path:last-child]:fill-neutral-200", "dark:[&>svg>g>path:last-child]:fill-neutral-800" ) const percent = (part: number, whole: number) => `${(part / whole) * 100}%` const screenStyle: CSSProperties = { left: percent(SCREEN.x, PHONE.width), top: percent(SCREEN.y, PHONE.height), width: percent(SCREEN.width, PHONE.width), height: percent(SCREEN.height, PHONE.height), borderRadius: `${percent(SCREEN.radius, SCREEN.width)} / ${percent(SCREEN.radius, SCREEN.height)}`, } const islandStyle: CSSProperties = { top: percent(ISLAND.y - SCREEN.y, SCREEN.height), width: percent(ISLAND.width, SCREEN.width), height: percent(ISLAND.height, SCREEN.height), } const COLLECTION = [ { title: "Small rituals, better days", detail: "Journal · 4 min read" }, { title: "Notes from the coast", detail: "Travel · 12 photos" }, { title: "An idea for tomorrow", detail: "Draft · Edited 9:41" }, { title: "Books for the long weekend", detail: "Reading list · 6 books" }, ] export default function PoisedSurfaceDemo2() { return (
